newsitem.title: UK: Celltech leads UK biotech stocks lower.
newsitem.headline: Celltech leads UK biotech stocks lower.

text.p: Shares in UK biotech companies dropped in early trading on Tuesday, unsettled by the collapse in a U.S. biotech stock after disappointing trial results from a leading drug.

AutoImmune Inc shares plummeted $9-7/16 to $4-5/16 after the company said it would put on hold the development of its Myloral therapy for multiple schlerosis, after a Phase III trial showed no difference in its effects compared with a placebo.
Celltech Plc was down 32-1/2p at 550 by 0711 GMT in thin trade of 14,500 shares and some other biotech stocks were also sharply lower.

British Biotechnology Plc was down 2-1/2p at 237-1/2, Shield Diagnostics Plc was down 20p at 477-1/2, Cantab Pharmaceutical Plc was down 20p at 985, Vanguard Medica Plc was down 12-1/p at 595 and Chiroscience Group Plc was down 12-1/2p at 356.
However, analysts said Tuesday's moves were an overreaction to the FT report and could provide a buying opportunity for shares in the often volatile sector.
"The risks that everyone knew were there have become apparent in one stock," said Erling Refsum, analyst at Yamaichi.
"The sector is based on confidence and is very volatile...you get a couple of minor disappointments and valuations go down."
He said confidence should recover once a flow of good news resumes from promising UK biotech companies.
"This is a non-specific, anxiety-inducing, price fall not related to any specific company here," he said.
